Struct ValueRange

ShapeEngine.Core.Structs

Represents a range of floating-point values with inclusive minimum and maximum bounds.

public readonly struct ValueRange : IEquatable<ValueRange>, IComparable<ValueRange>

Remarks

Provides utility methods for range operations, random value generation, clamping, remapping, and arithmetic operations.

GetHashCode()

Returns a hash code for the current ValueRange based on its stable quantized hash key.

public override int GetHashCode()

Returns

int

A 32-bit hash code representing this range.

Remarks

This method folds the 64-bit value returned by GetHashKey(int) into a 32-bit hash code suitable for .NET hashing APIs such as dictionaries and hash sets.
